{C:81930100}{C:81958296A33200000000}The Cloud Stream is changing
here too, right?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296A43200000000}Yeah.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A53200000000}Doesn't this make you feel
someone's behind it?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296A63200000000}Someone's behind it...? You don't mean...!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A73200000000}That's exactly what I mean.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296A83200000000}Are you saying someone's moving
the Cloud Stream?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A93200000000}That's right.
Don't you think it's strange?

{C:81958296AA3200000000}Every time we enter a continent,
the same thing happens.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296AB3200000000}I thought about that too.
But I soon gave up thinking about it.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296AC3200000000}So did I.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3200000000}Why?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296AE3200000000}But, big bro,
you know how many years it took
to overcome the Cloud Stream, don't you?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296AF3200000000}Exactly.
It took a genius like Professor Rondo
to make it possible in the first place.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B03200000000}And even if someone could do that,
who would be doing it,
and what for?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B13200000000}Well...

{C:81930400}{C:81958296B23200000000}Besides, I wouldn't want to fight
someone who could control nature itself.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B33200000000}You've got a point there.



{x00}

{C:81930C00}{C:819582963A2600000000}To let the Astante get as far as {C:819782830300}Pentagona{C:819782830000}
...

{C:819582963B2600000000}Posaydal's army
is utterly useless.

{C:81936E00}{C:819582963C2600000000}Boy.
I'm only letting you command
a fraction of my forces.

{C:81930C00}{C:819582963D2600000000}A fraction or otherwise,
that's none of my concern.
Useless is useless.

{C:81936E00}{C:819582963E2600000000}Then you don't mind if this ends

{C:81935700}{C:81958296422600000000}I don't like your tone.
Posaydal isn't as easy to beat
as you seem to think!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296432600000000}We've been taking on the Titans
with only a small force.
Don't underestimate us!

{C:81935700}{C:81958296442600000000}You've got to be kidding!
I'm not here
to help you in the first place!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296452600000000}What did you say!?!

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296850000000000}We've only been able to keep fighting
because we've worked together, right?

{C:81958296860000000000}The Astante can't keep going
if we carry on like this!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296462600000000}Don't you want
to end this war soon?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296870000000000}Of course I do!
I want to end it
as soon as possible too!!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296472600000000}Then...!

{C:81905700}{C:81958296482600000000}I can't take this anymore!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296492600000000}Leccee?

{C:81905700}{C:819582964A2600000000}I said I can't take it anymore!
I'm through playing at war
like children having a fight!!

{C:819582964B2600000000}I'm getting off this ship!
Goodbye!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964C2600000000}Leccee, wait!

{C:81905700}{C:819582964D2600000000}Don't bother trying to stop me!

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296532600000000}If Leccee were here,
we might know a little more.

{C:81958296542600000000}It could be a trap.
What will you do, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296552600000000}I'll ask him.

{C:81958296562600000000}Can you hear me, Mr. Kamandra?
I'm Rie Akatsuki, the captain.

{C:81958296572600000000}Could you tell me
why you want
to supply us?

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296582600000000}Why? It's quite simple.
You're from another continent,
and you interest me.

{C:81958296592600000000}So, will you come?
If you're worried, bring an escort.

{C:81900300}{C:819582965A2600000000}Understood.
We'll come and see you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B2600000000}Of course I'm coming with you.

{C:81908200}{C:819582965C2600000000}I'm partly responsible for what happened
with Leccee, so I'll come too.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582965D2600000000}Wait a moment.
There may be negotiations.
Surely this calls for a professional...


{C:8190A702}{C:819582965E2600000000}I wanna go too!

{C:8190A102}{C:819582965F2600000000}I'd like to go too.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296602600000000}Don't butt in, Hime.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296612600000000}What's that, You?
Don't you want to go?
You're curious, aren't you?

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296622600000000}Of course I am.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296642600000000}Wouldn't it be better
to send someone who can fight?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296652600000000}We shouldn't keep him waiting forever.
Rie, make the decision.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296662600000000}Um, then, big bro,
Sho... Kamille,
and Guy, please come with me.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296880000000000}Yeah, leave it to me.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296672600000000}Let's go.


{x00}

{C:81935300}{C:81958296702600000000}If we keep talking, Posaydal's army

{C:81930100}{C:81958296782600000000}Are you sure this is all right, Rain?

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296792600000000}The maintenance?
Leave it to me. It's my specialty.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2600000000}Thank you.

{C:8190B601}{C:819582967B2600000000}Thanks to Domon,
I know all too well how disastrous

Leave the maintenance to me.
Besides...

{C:81930100}{C:819582967D2600000000}Besides?

So it isn't that much work.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296822600000000}Make sure you thank Nelfea.

I'm counting on you.

{C:81905600}{C:81958296842600000000}What!? Don't tell me you're
the owners of that ship!
You're all just children!!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296852600000000}You're hardly any different
from us yourself.
What are you talking about?

{C:81905600}{C:81958296862600000000}What's your problem!?
You've got some nerve
talking to me like that!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296872600000000}Why are you picking a fight
right from the start,
Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296882600000000}But...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296892600000000}Anyway, where can we find Daba?

{C:81905600}{C:819582968A2600000000}Sooorry!
I came to show you the way, didn't I?
Daba? He's in the {C:819782830300}meeting hall{C:819782830000}.

{C:819582968B2600000000}By the way, wasn't that idiot Leccee
with you?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C2600000000}She's off the ship at the moment.

{C:81905600}{C:819582968D2600000000}I thought so.
She was in Posaydal's army, after all.

{C:81908200}{C:819582968E2600000000}Leccee used to be
in Posaydal's army!?

{C:81905600}{C:819582968F2600000000}What, you didn't even
know that?

{C:81958296902600000000}She was quite a big shot
in Posaydal's army,
one of the Thirteen.

{C:81958296922600000000}She fell for Daba and changed sides, though.
So she's not here...

{C:81958296942600000000}I've got a report to make,
so I'll go ahead and see Daba.
Come to the meeting hall, okay?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296952600000000}Don't just walk off like that!
You're so irresponsible and selfish!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81905300}{C:81958296A82600000000}You're the people who've been fighting
aboard the Astante, right?
It's a pleasure. I'm Daba Myroad.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AA2600000000}It's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Rie Akatsuki,
captain of the Astante.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296AB2600000000}And I'm one of her pilots,
Nelfea Northrock.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC2600000000}It's nice to meet you.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296AD2600000000}Welcome to Pentagona.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AE2600000000}About the ship from our continent...
Well... I'm sorry.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296AF2600000000}Why are you apologizing?
It's Posaydal's fault for using it.

{C:81958296B02600000000}If anything, we're more to blame.
We couldn't leave Pentagona,
and let Posaydal go unchecked.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B32600000000}That's not true at all.

{C:81905500}{C:81958296B42600000000}You both feel that way,
so isn't that good enough?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296B52600000000}Kyao!

{C:81958296B62600000000}This is my best friend and engineer,
{C:819782830400}Mirawoo Kyao{C:819782830000}.


{C:81905600}{C:81958296B72600000000}Daaaba!
Introduce me toooo!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296B82600000000}Amm, you went to meet them
and didn't even introduce yourself?
Honestly...

{C:81958296B92600000000}This is {C:819782830400}Fannaria Amm{C:819782830000}.
And, um...
How should I introduce you?

{C:81905600}{C:81958296BA2600000000}Ohhh, Daba, you're sooo mean!
Your girl-friend!
That's all you have to say.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296BB2600000000}But you're not, are you?
Anyway, she's one of our companions.

{C:81958296BC2600000000}About our next move,
we've also got allies in {C:819782830300}Mizun{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296BD2600000000}Could you head over there
for the time being?


{C:81905500}{C:81958296BE2600000000}You're going to Mizun?
Then I'll go on ahead.





{x00}

{C:81906F00}{C:81958296252700000000}Welcome.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296262700000000}Amandra Kamandra!
Why are you here!?

{C:81906F00}{C:81958296272700000000}I'm a merchant.
The longer the war goes on, the better.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296292700000000}How could you...!!

{C:81905700}{C:819582962A2700000000}We haven't got time
for idle chatter, Daba.

{C:81908200}{C:819582962B2700000000}L-Leccee!
Why are you here!?

{C:81905700}{C:819582962C2700000000}Lady Posaydal is waiting.
Pick five to come to {C:819782830300}Sveto{C:819782830000},

{C:81930100}{C:819582962D2700000000}Choose?

{C:81905700}{C:819582962E2700000000}Surely you didn't think
every last one of you could
have an audience with Lady Posaydal?

{C:81905300}{C:819582962F2700000000}What shall we do?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302700000000}Daba knows this continent,
so he'll be coming with me...

{C:81958296312700000000}Roger, Sai Saici,
Chirico, I'm counting on you.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296910000000000}That's our man!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296322700000000}Wouldn't it be better

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296352700000000}Welcome,
you who defy me.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296362700000000}Posaydal!
Put an end to
this pointless war!!

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296372700000000}What are you saying, boy?
You cannot defeat me.

{C:81958296382700000000}Surrender.
I'll still forgive you if you do it now.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296392700000000}With respect, Your Majesty,
there's a proper order to negotiations.
Wouldn't you agree?

{C:81906E00}{C:819582963A2700000000}Negotiations?
Ah ha ha ha ha!

{C:819582963B2700000000}What are you talking about?
I'm not negotiating.
I'm giving orders.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582963C2700000000}This is pointless. Let's return to the ship.

{C:81905300}{C:819582963D2700000000}Please wait, Roger.

{C:819582963E2700000000}Posaydal!
No one will accept your dictatorship!
Give it up already!!

{C:81906E00}{C:819582963F2700000000}Is that wrong, boy?

{C:81958296402700000000}A dictatorship that toughens its people is good.
Those who overcome it
will be the people who build a better tomorrow.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296930000000000}Talk about a self-serving excuse!
And you'll borrow the power of other continents
to do it, will you, lady?

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296412700000000}I do not wish to see Pentagona
filled with unnecessary power.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296422700000000}Then there's no need
for you to wage war!

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296432700000000}When the world falls into disorder, malice erupts.
When chaos rules,
the vile pus is forced out.

{C:81958296442700000000}To create a new world,
a vortex of chaos
must constantly be stirred up.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296452700000000}Don't dress it up in pretty words, Posaydal!!

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296472700000000}To rule the world, you cannot always
just brandish justice.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582964B2700000000}The audience is over, then.
Let's return to the ship...
Rie and the others are waiting.

{C:81906E00}{C:819582964C2700000000}Do as you wish.
If you can get back... that is.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296502700000000}We're trapped on every side...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296522700000000}Isn't there anything you can do?
I thought you might be able
to manage something, Chirico.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296532700000000}Even I can't do this.
The conditions are too bad.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296950000000000}What do we do, big bro?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296542700000000}Honestly...
I thought this might happen.
You can get out this way.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296552700000000}You left your companions in anger,
then greeted us as one of Posaydal's soldiers.
Isn't it unreasonable to ask us to trust you?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296562700000000}Is that true, Leccee?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296572700000000}It's true that I left,
but that was...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296582700000000}That way

Let's hurry.


{C:81905700}{C:81958296592700000000}You trust me?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965A2700000000}What's there to doubt?
You left because you saw
this coming, didn't you?

{C:819582965B2700000000}Thank you, Leccee.
You're saving us.

{C:81905700}{C:819582965C2700000000}Let's hurry back to the Astante.

{C:81900400}{C:819582965E2700000000}I've learned by now
that he's more dependable than I thought.

{C:819582965F2700000000}So the right thing to do
is stay back and support him, isn't it?
